entries.125beb91ef6a2ff1: NICHIREKI GROUP CO., LTD. is a holding company with its head office in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, and forms a group with 40 consolidated subsidiaries and four affiliates. The number of consolidated employees is 1,434 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.18282271b5cbd4f5: From fiscal 2026, it is implementing a five-year medium-term management plan, “Nobiyaka 2030.” Its priority measures are strengthening the customer base, strengthening organizational capabilities, strengthening the business base through “Tsukuba Big Ship,” a production and logistics base under construction in Tsukubamirai City, Ibaraki Prefecture, advancing supply chain management, and strengthening the management base, and it aims to build a sustainable corporate group by expanding the provision of environmentally considerate products and construction methods with low-carbon, long-life and recyclable performance. Because the plan’s numerical targets are forward-looking, they are not presented here.

entries.2d645215d350afbc: It has set out a business model of “Michizukuri” that fully integrates the provision of road paving materials and construction methods that satisfy both superior functionality and cost, advanced consulting that watches over roads, and construction technology that customers trust. With Nichireki Co., Ltd., which manufactures and sells products, at its core, subsidiaries across the country carry out construction work, enabling the group to provide a consistent offering from development of materials and construction methods through to construction.
